pages.text: A black hole of mass M glows at $(thing)T = ħc³/(8πGMk)$(), radiates power ∝ 1/M², and evaporates in a time ∝ M³. A stellar hole is colder than the sky; one of a billion kilograms, hotter than any star.

The $(item)Micro Black Hole Evaporator$() holds one (a Kugelblitz Seed in a slot) and feeds it dust exactly as fast as it radiates. Feed it less and it shrinks, heats, runs away and explodes; more, and it swells. Below 6×10⁸ kg its gamma rays are too much for the lead. It gives great power and $(fluid)Hawking Radiation$(); above 10¹³ K, $(item)Hawking Quanta$() too.
